scenario.zh: 为扩张的工程团队采购50台工作站，对比供应商并优化条款
scenario.en: Procure 50 workstations for expanding engineering team, compare vendors and optimize terms

instruction.zh: 选择采购策略以启动供应商搜寻
instruction.en: Choose procurement strategy to begin vendor search

output.zh: 工作区更新：需求文档添加集成交付要求和单点联系人条款
output.en: Workspace updated: brief includes integrated delivery and single point of contact terms

output.zh: 工作区更新：需求文档拆分为设备采购和安装服务两个标段
output.en: Workspace updated: brief split into equipment acquisition and installation service packages

instruction.zh: 选择供应商评估维度以生成RFQ
instruction.en: Choose vendor evaluation criteria to generate RFQ

output.zh: 工作区更新：RFQ强调60天交付承诺，包含阶段交付里程碑条款
output.en: Workspace updated: RFQ emphasizes 60-day delivery commitment with milestone terms

output.zh: 工作区更新：RFQ要求分项报价，包含数量折扣和付款条件谈判空间
output.en: Workspace updated: RFQ requests itemized pricing with volume discounts and payment terms

instruction.zh: 选择供应商方案进入合同谈判
instruction.en: Select vendor proposal for contract negotiation

output.zh: 工作区更新：合同草案包含75天交付、现场技术支持和本地化保修条款
output.en: Workspace updated: contract draft with 75-day delivery, on-site support, local warranty

output.zh: 工作区更新：合同草案包含较低单价、90天交付和集中式远程支持条款
output.en: Workspace updated: contract draft with lower unit cost, 90-day delivery, centralized support

instruction.zh: 确认最终采购决策并生成内部审批文档
instruction.en: Confirm final procurement decision and generate internal approval document

output.zh: 采购简报已准备：包含选定供应商、谈判条款摘要和风险缓释措施
output.en: Procurement brief ready: includes selected vendor, negotiated terms summary, risk mitigation

output.zh: 工作区更新：合同中付款时间表和验收标准条款已高亮供法务审查
output.en: Workspace updated: payment schedule and acceptance criteria clauses highlighted for legal review

takeaway.zh: SpaceFlow将RFQ生成、供应商比较和合同条款优化整合为端到端采购流程
takeaway.en: SpaceFlow integrates RFQ generation, vendor comparison, and contract optimization into end-to-end procurement

initial.zh: 工程工作站×50，i9处理器/64GB内存/RTX显卡，需90天内交付，预算$15万
initial.en: Engineering workstations×50, i9/64GB/RTX GPU, delivery within 90 days, budget $150k
